statement: GX-21: errors when the files touch the units of several lanes (the lane is undecidable and the train would refuse it), listing each unit with its lane.
note: Seeded by scripts/model seed-rules (PADRAO-DEV F1b); its statement and types are to be reviewed. Basis: D-326 (dormant: the lane matters only to the train, stopped by D-314). GX-21 (docs/units/GX21) defined "lane undecidable"; D-065 (4) / D-067 (2) give each unit one exclusive lane.
